reuse.why: Changes the rule inside the existing exported getScheduledAmount helper and routes every inline midpoint copy (template, forecast, updateActions, posting, preview) through it.

duplication.why: Removes five inline copies of the range-to-amount logic; the new rule exists once.

placement.why: The amount rule stays in shared/schedules where the helper already lived and is consumed by server and client alike.

scope.why: Only the amount rule, its call sites, tests and a release note are touched.

maintainability.why: A single definition decides missing, numeric and ranged amounts for every consumer; only a stale 'average' comment in Balance.tsx remains.

one_place.where: shared/schedules.ts getScheduledAmount, now used by schedule-template, forecast-schedules normalizeSchedule, schedules/app updateActions and postTransactionForSchedule, computeSchedulePreviewTransactions and the client components
